notes: «و روى إبراهيم بن هاشم أن ...» opens the report: Ibrahim is the first link, and he relays a narrated story about Ibn Abi Umayr.

Inside the story Ibn Abi Umayr gives his own isnad for the Imam's words («حدثني ذريح المحاربي عن أبي عبد الله»): a second saying with its own isnad, so the case is flagged (rule 11) and that isnad is not written as a route here.
«رضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ» and «عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» are blessings and are left out.
